title: Sheds everywhere every day
text:
Sheds everywhere every day. On one hand, I really like this blanket. On the other hand, it aggravates me a bit. It's very soft and feels great to snuggle under with a book. It's thin and not heavy at all.

However, the thing sheds. Constantly and we're finding fuzzy fibers on the dogs, the sofa, the floor and in the washer filter. It's obnoxious enough to make me consider just tossing it out before I bother to wash it again.
